The Retail Buyer will be responsible for selecting, purchasing and coordinating the supply of fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce for the business’s retail, wholesale, hospitality and export customers.

Monitor sales data, customer orders, stock levels and product movement to identify purchasing requirements.

Study fresh produce market conditions, seasonal availability, supplier information, pricing trends and supply shortages.

Select and purchase fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce from farmers, growers, wholesalers and market suppliers.

Inspect, compare and assess produce before purchase, including freshness, quality, grading, size, shelf life and suitability for resale or export.

Negotiate purchase prices, quantities, delivery schedules, payment terms, promotional arrangements and supply conditions with suppliers.

Compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability, delivery capacity, freight costs, seasonal availability and consistency of supply.

Prepare buying plans based on customer demand, retail and wholesale orders, budget requirements, seasonal supply and export needs.

Anticipate consumer demand and determine the quantity, quality and variety of produce to be purchased.

Liaise with management regarding long-term purchasing plans, pricing strategies, product promotions and seasonal sales campaigns.

Recommend retail, wholesale and export pricing based on purchase costs, freight costs, market demand, wastage risk and profit margins.

Coordinate product range, promotional stock allocation and merchandising/display strategies with retail and operations staff.

Maintain strong supplier relationships with farmers, growers, wholesalers, market suppliers and transport providers.

Source produce suitable for hospitality customers and export supply, including produce with appropriate freshness, quality, shelf life and transport timing.

Respond to supply disruptions, price increases or poor seasonal availability by identifying alternative suppliers or substitute products.

Work with internal staff to ensure purchased produce is properly received, recorded, quality checked, stored and allocated.

Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier terms, price comparisons, delivery commitments and stock planning information.

Prepare supplier comparison reports, seasonal market updates, purchasing recommendations and stock movement reports.

Travel as required to farms, wholesale markets, supplier premises and regional distribution areas to inspect produce and assess market conditions.

AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV

Strong knowledge of fresh produce, seasonality, quality standards and pricing fluctuations.

Strong negotiation skills with farmers, growers, wholesalers and suppliers.

Ability to analyse sales data, customer demand, stock levels and product movement.

Ability to compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability and delivery capacity.

Understanding of pricing margins, freight costs, promotional planning and wastage risk.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Strong planning, reporting, research and organizational skills.

Ability to travel regularly across metropolitan and regional locations.

Ability to make commercially sound purchasing decisions.

Grand Guru offers an authentic North Indian dining experience, serving a wide variety of traditional Indian dishes prepared using fresh ingredients, aromatic spices, and time-honoured recipes. Grand Guru is seeking a skilled and motivated Cook to join our busy kitchen team on a full-time basis (38 hours per week).

The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing and cooking quality meals, assisting with kitchen operations, maintaining food safety standards, and supporting the Head Chef in daily kitchen activities. The role requires experience in preparing Indian cuisine and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

•	Prepare and cook a wide variety of authentic North Indian dishes in accordance with established recipes, quality standards and presentation requirements.

•	Set up and organise kitchen workstations with the required ingredients, equipment and utensils prior to service. 
•	Operate and regulate the temperatures of tandoor ovens, grills, cooktops, fryers and other kitchen equipment to ensure food is cooked correctly and consistently. 
•	Examine raw ingredients and foodstuffs to ensure quality, freshness and compliance with food safety standards. 
•	Portion, plate and garnish meals in accordance with the restaurant's presentation standards and ensure timely service. 
•	Monitor food quality throughout preparation and cooking to maintain consistency and customer satisfaction. 
•	Store food appropriately, rotate stock in accordance with food safety requirements, and monitor stock levels of ingredients and kitchen supplies, reporting shortages to management. 
•	Assist the Head Chef with daily food preparation, menu items, specials and estimating ingredient requirements to minimise waste. 
•	Prepare meals to accommodate customers' dietary requirements and reasonable special requests. 
•	Maintain a clean and hygienic kitchen by cleaning work areas, equipment and utensils, and complying with all food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Assist in training and supporting junior kitchen staff and apprentices and work collaboratively with the Head Chef and kitchen team to ensure efficient kitchen operations.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
•	Relevant qualification in Commercial Cookery or related field;
•	Minimum 1 year of experience in a similar Cook position within a busy restaurant or cafe environment;
•	Experience and knowledge in preparing and cooking North Indian dishes;
•	Ability to operate commercial kitchen equipment safely and effectively;
•	Strong understanding of food hygiene and kitchen safety standards;
•	Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment;
•	Good communication and teamwork skills;
•	Strong organisational and time management abilities.

At Mushroom People Pty Ltd, we are a proud family-owned and operated gourmet mushroom farm located on the west side of Melbourne. Our deep passion for seeing mushrooms grow and staying connected to nature is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in sustainable, environmentally friendly farming practices that look after our local community and promote a healthier planet. Every single one of our gourmet varieties (including exotic Oyster and Lion's Mane varieties) is grown with love and delivered fresh to restaurants, grocery stores, and wholesalers across Australia.

As we expand our production, we are looking for a dedicated full-time Horticultural Grower (Mushroom Grower) (working 38 hours per week) to join our tight-knit farm family and help us grow with love.

The base salary offered is 79,500 - 82,500 per annum plus superannuation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

- Planning and coordinating the cultivation, production, and marketing of gourmet mushroom crops from initial substrate preparation to final harvest, taking into careful account environmental variables and shifting market factors.
- Selecting, preparing, and inoculating grain spawn and liquid cultures, while grafting and testing new exotic mushroom strains to optimize crop resilience and yield.
- Maintaining optimal indoor crop production cycles by cultivating mycelium blocks, de-budding excess pinheads, monitoring flushing intervals, and adjusting climate control infrastructure.
- Organising and conducting daily commercial farming operations, including the strategic collecting, cold storage, strict grading, and eco-friendly packaging of fresh gourmet produce.
- Directing the sale, purchase, and dispatch of mushroom products to local wholesalers, restaurants, and grocery networks to meet tight delivery contracts.
- Overseeing general bio-secure farming activities, with a strict focus on non-chemical pest management, pathogen controls, and rigorous environmental hygiene.
